items.fdc_query: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
items.preparation: Boiled or steamed cross-cut corn cob rounds; kernels only, cob core excluded; no added butter or salt visible

fdc.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

rows: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels on cob, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

scale_cues: White square plate about 25-27 cm across used as scale. Each corn round is roughly 5-6 cm in diameter, about a fifth of the plate width. Estimate assumes two rounds of about 2.5 cm thickness.
assumptions: Two corn cob rounds, each about 45-50 g of edible kernels; the white central cob core is inedible and excluded from the mass.
Thickness is not visible from overhead, so mass is inferred from diameter and typical cob-round dimensions.
No butter, salt, or other sauce is visible, so none is logged.
Kernels are assumed cooked, not raw, based on the yellow color and soft appearance.
